{{Quote|This popular sandwich boasts sliced Manpha-fowl, nuna bacon, Revwien lettuce and topato. Served on toasted or therm-zapped pseudograin bread.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Shawda Clubb sandwich|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Shawda Clubb sandwich''' was a type of [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It consisted of slices of [[Manpha-fowl]], [[nuna bacon]], [[Revwien lettuce]], and [[Topato/Legends|topatos]], all served on toasted or thermo-zapped [[pseudograin bread]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] sold the sandwich for 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as part of its [[Foodstuff/Legends|lunch]] favorites<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Shawda Clubb sandwiches were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" /> The sandwich's name is a pun referencing the [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] [[species]] and real-world [[Wikipedia:club sandwich|club sandwiches]].<ref name="blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>
